hero.title: Growing the Future of Food
hero.description: We're on a mission to make sustainable seafood accessible at home. Aquacubes combines closed-loop aquaculture with nature's wisdom, so anyone can grow fresh, healthy food without a farm.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Aquacubes started with a simple question: why should growing your own fresh seafood and greens require a farm? We design closed-loop aquaculture systems that fit in a home, a classroom, or a small commercial kitchen.
Every system is built to handle the hard parts automatically — water quality, temperature, feeding schedules — so you can focus on the harvest.

items.title: Sustainability
items.description: We believe food production should give back more than it takes. Every Aquacubes system uses 90% less water and zero chemicals.

items.title: Innovation
items.description: Technology should serve nature, not replace it. Our smart sensors work with biological processes, not against them.

items.title: Community
items.description: Food connects people. We're building a global community of home aquaculturists who share knowledge, harvests, and stories.

cta.title: Ready to Start Growing?
cta.description: Join the food revolution. Your first harvest is closer than you think.
